tools.name: check_institution
tools.description: Find a bank, credit union or brokerage by name and say which finance apps likely connect to it. Pass `app` to focus on one app. If several institutions share the name, the largest is used and the others are listed; pass `state` or call get_institution with the right URL.

tools.name: search_institutions
tools.description: Search 8,500+ US banks, credit unions and brokerages by name (and optionally city). Returns matches with their Plaid status and page URLs, largest institutions first.

tools.name: get_institution
tools.description: Full app-by-app results for one institution: status and reason per app, the name to search for in the app, FAQs and identifiers. Takes a URL or path from search_institutions.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: The finance apps PlugCat tracks: budgeting apps and accounting tools, the bank-data providers each uses, prices and whether they link investment accounts.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_institution, search_institutions, get_institution · Public sink: check_institution.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_institution, search_institutions, get_institution · Public sink: check_institution

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
